PHYSICS — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #6
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: PHYSICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Iron rusting
   B. Ice melting to water
   C. Milk souring
   D. Paper burning to ash

2. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Only water vapour
   B. Nitrogen gas only
   C. Glucose and oxygen
   D. Only carbon dioxide

3. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Burning crop residue every week
   B. Removing all vegetation
   C. Overgrazing continuously
   D. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes

4. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Petrol fires have no fuel
   B. Water removes heat too quickly
   C. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   D. Water always increases oxygen

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Dynamics? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Dynamics.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Dynamics.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Dynamics.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Dynamics.

6. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 100 °C
   B. 50 °C
   C. 37 °C
   D. 0 °C

7. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. watt (W)
   B. joule (J)
   C. pascal (Pa)
   D. newton (N)

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Introduction to Satellites? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Introduction to Satellites.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Introduction to Satellites.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Introduction to Satellites.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Introduction to Satellites.

9. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   B. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   C. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   D. A compound can be separated by filtering only

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Transistors? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Transistors.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Transistors.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Transistors.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Transistors.

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Electromagnetic induction? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Electromagnetic induction.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Electromagnetic induction.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Electromagnetic induction.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Electromagnetic induction.

12. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Movement of water only across a membrane
   B. A chemical reaction forming ash
   C. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   D. Heating until a solid melts

13. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Mains electricity? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Mains electricity.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Mains electricity.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Mains electricity.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Mains electricity.

14. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Quantity of Heat? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Quantity of Heat.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Quantity of Heat.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Quantity of Heat.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Quantity of Heat.

15. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Introduction to Satellites Page 12 of 49 1 STRAND 1.0 MECHANICS AND THERMAL PHYS? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Introduction to Satellites Page 12 of 49 1 STRAND 1.0 MECHANICS AND THERMAL PHYS.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Introduction to Satellites Page 12 of 49 1 STRAND 1.0 MECHANICS AND THERMAL PHYS.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Introduction to Satellites Page 12 of 49 1 STRAND 1.0 MECHANICS AND THERMAL PHYS.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Introduction to Satellites Page 12 of 49 1 STRAND 1.0 MECHANICS AND THERMAL PHYS.

16. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Thin lenses? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Thin lenses.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Thin lenses.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Thin lenses.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Thin lenses.

17. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Primary consumers only
   B. Tertiary consumers
   C. Producers
   D. Decomposers only

18. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Circular motion? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Circular motion.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Circular motion.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Circular motion.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Circular motion.

19. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. Any substance that conducts electricity
   B. Any white crystal used in cooking
   C. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   D. A mixture of two liquids

20. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Photoelectric effect? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Photoelectric effect.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Photoelectric effect.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Photoelectric effect.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Photoelectric effect.

21. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Floating and Sinking? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Floating and Sinking.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Floating and Sinking.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Floating and Sinking.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Floating and Sinking.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
22. In three clear sentences, explain Quantity of Heat and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

23. In three clear sentences, explain Thin lenses and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

24. In three clear sentences, explain Photoelectric effect and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

27. In three clear sentences, explain Transistors and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

30. In three clear sentences, explain Dynamics and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

31. In three clear sentences, explain Circular motion and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
